text:
nora: heads-up — onboarding hit a weird sanitizer/parsing gap with fncall outputs. customer integration surfaced a union-output case: tool can return either an object or a JSON string depending on model, and our sanitize pass is being too eager after an auth-retry so they get rejected downstream.
paul: can you give a short repro?
nora: steps: 1) sdk.fn.call('extract', ...) with schema expecting {id:int, meta:object} | string 2) streaming enabled, preserveSchema=false 3) mid-call auth refresh triggers retry 4) retry wrapper replays buffered payload which was kept as rawText (string) and sanitizer does JSON.parse blindly, turning string -> object unexpectedly. consumer validator then fails because schema path expected the original string branch.
ida: wow that is subtle. our sanitizer tries to be helpful in coerce mode (it parses JSON strings into objects when schema has object branch). but here the model intended a string branch (raw textual id), so parse changes branch selection.
jon: short-term workaround: add a flag sanitizeOptions: { preserveTextBranch: true } to validateToolOutput so caller can opt out of parse-over-eager coercion. long-term: we should move parsing responsibility to a single boundary (streamer/retry) and have validateToolOutput operate on normalized typed values.
paul: agree. propose a sanitizer API: normalizeFnOutput(schema, { preferRawString:boolean | null, mode: 'strict'|'coerce' }) that returns either the typed object or an explicit RawString wrapper so validators can decide. that makes parity easier for node+py.
ida: also note parity gap: node's validateToolOutput currently does safeParseStrings by default; python requires explicit sanitize() call. that's likely why more py users hit this. we need to align default behavior and add tests.
jon: i'll draft a small RFC: 1) Stream/Retry expose buffer entries with explicit format tag ("json"|"text"); 2) Retry should prefer structured payload when format=="json" and reserialize deterministically; 3) normalizeFnOutput handles union disambiguation and exposes preserveTextBranch option.
paul: test plan: unit tests for normalizeFnOutput on union schemas, integration that simulates auth refresh mid-stream, verify both node & python validateToolOutput produce same branch result. add to CI matrix.
ida: temporary PR with conservative fix (opt-in preserveTextBranch) opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/789 — labeled WIP. IT unblocks this customer but we should land the RFC for a real fix.
devex-bot: created issue #3205: "fncall sanitizer + retry double-parse flips union branch; add normalizeFnOutput + parity tests" assigned to @paul
paul: i'll own the parity tests and the node side impl. assigning python follow-up to @ida. thanks for the clear repro, nora :thumbsup:
nora: thanks — customer unblocked with opt-in flag but please land the long-term fix before next sample-kit release so new users don't hit this during onboarding.
